test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LP-MQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6ed48ac003fa6676565d91bfaa1d98a2a6236deca99dc67066d3af52be4e306.png] 

Option 2) FJ-GI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72dbadd42a48d507197713a0db8bfc80e5022ead2dbcd7daadfb5141580477a2.png] 

Option 3) IM-JL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8eb36277faeb41aa8c342881dd9778fccac4c7af0cbc895b65c3fc7a621a382.png] 

Option 4) QU-RT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76bd575a8f14cd97dad3abd92c7fba93ae09bb3acbdd7764c42c739275443322.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'LP-MQ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer
